description: Create data layer: Task type, AsyncStorage utilities, and useTasks hook with weekly completion tracking. Weekly reset is implemented as a computed filter (tasks completed in current ISO week) not a destructive reset.
steps: Create src/types/task.ts with Task interface (id, title, category: 'personal'|'school', deadline: string ISO, isPriority: boolean, isCompleted: boolean, completedAt?: string ISO, createdAt: string ISO, weekKey?: string 'YYYY-WW')
Create src/utils/storage.ts with loadTasks() and saveTasks(tasks: Task[]) functions using AsyncStorage from @react-native-async-storage/async-storage with key 'TASKS_DATA'
Create src/utils/date-helpers.ts with getCurrentWeekKey() returning 'YYYY-WW' format and isCurrentWeek(weekKey: string | undefined) boolean helper

Create src/hooks/use-tasks.ts: useState for tasks array, useEffect to load on mount, useEffect to save on change, functions addTask/updateTask/deleteTask/toggleComplete (sets completedAt and weekKey on complete), computed stats (totalCount, completedThisWeek filtering by isCurrentWeek, pendingCount)
acceptance_criteria: Task interface defined with all required fields in src/types/task.ts
AsyncStorage functions work for loading and saving task arrays
useTasks hook exposes tasks array and CRUD functions
Completed count filters by current week using weekKey comparison
toggleComplete sets isCompleted, completedAt timestamp, and weekKey on completion
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` to verify types compile
Import useTasks in a test component and verify it returns expected shape
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Task interface created with all required fields. AsyncStorage utilities (loadTasks/saveTasks) implemented with error handling. useTasks hook provides CRUD operations (addTask, updateTask, deleteTask, toggleComplete) with stats tracking. Weekly completion tracking uses computed filter via getCurrentWeekKey() and isCurrentWeek() helpers - non-destructive approach preserves all task data. TypeScript compilation and linting passed for all new files.
